title: SafePal data breach impacts 39,798 customers, stolen info for sale
summary: The company says it notified all impacted customers via email on August 16 with the subject "[Important] Your SafePal Order Information Has Been Affected." SafePal has also launched an online verification tool that lets customers enter their order number and shipping country…
